notes: Documents: a library of the files that came out of your sessions. HTML renders in a sandboxed frame, PDFs, images, Markdown and CSV natively; a document opens as a tab, beside a conversation, full-screen on the phone, or in your device's own viewer. Share as a private, link or public document, all served by Pocket itself. Keep a file from a session's Results, upload one, or let agents keep deliverables with the new pocket-docs command. Off until you turn it on in Settings → Tools.
